name: Introduction - Consumet
snippet: Welcome to the documentation for Consumet - a collection of high-level, search engine APIs that provide accurate information about numerous entertainment mediums (such as anime, manga, light novels, movies etc.), along with links to stream these contents from publicly-available online sources.
